entries.question: holder jaanch mein Kitna time lagta hai
entries.answer:
Holter monitoring (जिसे आप 'holder jaanch' कह रहे हैं) में आमतौर पर **24 से 48 घंटे** का समय लगता है।

इस जांच के दौरान आपको एक छोटा सा पोर्टेबल डिवाइस पहनना होता है जो आपके दिल की धड़कन (ECG) को लगातार रिकॉर्ड करता है। डिवाइस लगाने के बाद आप अपने सामान्य काम कर सकते हैं, और तय समय (24 या 48 घंटे) पूरा होने के बाद आपको डिवाइस वापस अस्पताल में जमा करना होता है।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
* **सलाह:** यह जांच कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग (Lari Cardiology) से संबंधित है। कृपया अपनी रिपोर्ट और डॉक्टर की सलाह के लिए सीधे विभाग में संपर्क करें।
* **सावधानी:** मैं एक AI हूँ, डॉक्टर नहीं। यदि आपको सीने में दर्द, सांस लेने में तकलीफ या घबराहट जैसी कोई गंभीर समस्या है, तो कृपया तुरंत KGMU के **ट्रॉमा सेंटर (Gate 14)** या निकटतम आपातकालीन विभाग (Emergency) में जाएं।

अपनी सेहत के बारे में कोई भी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी या रिपोर्ट यहाँ साझा न करें। कृपया अधिक जानकारी के लिए KGMU की वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](http://www.kgmu.org) देखें या कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग के PRO कार्यालय से संपर्क करें।

entries.question: What will be the admission process
entries.answer:
The admission process for the B.Sc. Nursing program at KGMU generally follows these steps:

1.  **Notification:** KGMU releases an official admission brochure and notification on their website (www.kgmu.org) under the [Courses & Admission](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) section. This document contains the exact dates, eligibility criteria, and seat intake for the academic session.
2.  **Entrance Examination:** Admission is typically based on a competitive entrance examination conducted by the university (or a designated state-level body). You must apply online through the official portal when the application window opens.
3.  **Application Form:** You will need to fill out the online application form, upload required documents (photographs, signatures, and educational certificates), and pay the application fee.
4.  **Admit Card:** Once the application process closes, the university will release admit cards for the entrance exam.
5.  **Counseling:** After the results are declared, qualified candidates are called for counseling. During this phase, you will select your course/college based on your rank, verify your documents, and complete the seat allotment process.
6.  **Admission:** Upon successful seat allotment and document verification, you will pay the required admission fees to secure your seat.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Eligibility:** Ensure you meet the minimum educational requirements (typically 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English) as specified in the official brochure.
*   **Stay Updated:** Please regularly check the [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) and the admissions page for the latest updates, as the process for 2026 will be announced closer to the academic cycle.

entries.question: Pre operative instruction kya hota hai
entries.answer:
Pre-operative instructions are guidelines given to patients before a surgery or medical procedure. These instructions are crucial for ensuring the patient's safety and optimizing the success of the surgery.

They typically include information about:

*   **Fasting:** Instructions on when to stop eating and drinking before the surgery. This is vital to prevent complications during anesthesia.
*   **Medications:** Guidance on which medications to take or stop taking before the procedure, and when.
*   **Hygiene:** Advice on showering or bathing with specific soaps.
*   **What to bring:** A list of essential items to bring to the hospital on the day of surgery.
*   **What to wear:** Instructions on comfortable clothing.
*   **Transportation:** Arrangements for someone to drive you home after the surgery.
*   **Contact information:** Whom to contact if you have any questions or concerns.

Following these instructions carefully is very important. If you have any doubts or questions about the pre-operative instructions you have received, please do not hesitate to ask your doctor or the hospital staff.

entries.question: Online appointment
entries.answer:
To book an online appointment at KGMU, you must use the **Online Registration System (ORS)**. Please note that online registration is mandatory.

### **Booking Methods**

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Login/Register → Select State (**Uttar Pradesh**) → Select Hospital (**King George's Medical University**) → Choose Department and Date → Enter Patient Details → Pay **₹50** online → Download the appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **ORS Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same steps as the portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT <PATIENT NAME>"** to **8887019134**. You will receive a confirmation message.

**4. Telephone Helpline**
*   Call **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333** for assistance with booking.

### **Important Information**
*   **Fee:** ₹50 flat for the OPD slip.
*   **OPD Timings:** 
    *   Mon–Fri: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
    *   Sat: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
    *   *Closed on Sundays and Gazetted Holidays.*
*   **Location:** Most new appointments are seen at the **New OPD Building (Gate 2)**.
*   **Outside-city patients:** You must bring a valid referral for your specific department.

**Note:** It is strongly recommended to pre-book your slot to avoid long wait times, as the registration counters close at 1:00 PM sharp.

entries.question: Are admissions open right now for bsc radiology?
entries.answer:
Admissions for various courses at KGMU, including B.Sc. in Radiotherapy or Radiology-related paramedical courses, are usually conducted annually through entrance examinations.

To check the current status of admissions and whether the application portal is active for the current session, please visit the official **KGMU Admissions Page**: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

You should also regularly monitor the **KGMU Notice Board** for the latest admission notifications and entrance exam schedules: [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php)

entries.question: How to apply for bsc radiology course
entries.answer:
To apply for a B.Sc. program at King George's Medical University, please follow these steps:

1.  **Monitor Notifications:** KGMU admissions for B.Sc. and other paramedical courses are strictly based on entrance examinations or state-level selection processes. You must check the [Admissions Page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) and the [Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) regularly for the official admission brochure and exam schedule.
2.  **Check Eligibility:** Ensure you meet the academic requirements (typically 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics) as specified in the official brochure released for that specific academic year.
3.  **Application Process:** When the portal is active:
    *   Visit the official website: [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org).
    *   Follow the link for "Online Admission" or "Entrance Examination."
    *   Register using a valid email ID and mobile number.
    *   Fill out the application form carefully with your personal and academic details.
    *   Upload the required documents (photographs, signature, and academic certificates).
    *   Pay the application fee online through the provided payment gateway.
4.  **Entrance Exam:** Once the application is submitted, you will be required to appear for the entrance test on the date specified by the university.
5.  **Counseling:** If you qualify based on the merit list, you will be invited for online or in-person counseling, where seat allocation will take place.

Please keep an eye on the official website for the most accurate and up-to-date information regarding the application window for the current session.

entries.question: Hi want to book appointment for Dr sn kureel
entries.answer:
To book an appointment with **Dr. S. N. Kureel** (Department of Pediatric Surgery), please follow the mandatory online registration process:

### **Booking Methods**
1.  **Online (ORS Portal):** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh → King George's Medical University → Pediatric Surgery.
2.  **Mobile App:** Download the **ABHA (Health Care)** app from the Play Store and follow the hospital selection steps.
3.  **Phone/SMS:** 
    *   Call **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
    *   SMS **"APPOINTMENT <NAME>"** to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in:** You can visit the registration counters at the New OPD Building with your **Aadhaar Card**.

### **OPD Details**
*   **Department:** Pediatric Surgery
*   **Location:** New OPD Building, 4th Floor, Room No. 422.
*   **OPD Days:** Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
*   **Timings:** Mon–Fri (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) | Sat (9:00 AM–12:00 PM).
*   **Fee:** ₹50 flat for the OPD slip.

**Important Note:** The registration counter for physical slips closes at **1:00 PM sharp**. It is strongly recommended to pre-book online to avoid long wait times. If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you bring a valid referral.
